Meta.title: Voxylio — Real-time video dubbing in your browser
Meta.description: A Chrome extension that dubs any subtitled video in real time — into 65+ languages. Local translation, voice synced with playback.

Hero.title: Watch any video in <accent>your language</accent>
Hero.subtitle: Voxylio is a Chrome extension that dubs subtitled videos in real time. It rebuilds full sentences from the captions, translates them locally, and speaks over the video — in sync with playback.
Hero.note: Works on videos whose player exposes a subtitle track — most course platforms do.

Features.title: Built like a real dubbing studio
Features.subtitle: Not a robotic caption reader. Voxylio reconstructs sentences, keeps one consistent voice, and adapts its pace to the speaker.

sentences.title: Full-sentence dubbing
sentences.description: Caption fragments are merged into complete sentences before translation, so the voice flows naturally and translations keep their context.

local.title: Local translation
local.description: Uses Chrome's built-in on-device translation API first — free, private and offline-friendly — with an online fallback when unavailable.

sync.title: Always in sync
sync.description: Speech follows the video clock: pause, seek or replay and the voice follows instantly. Gentle rate adaptation keeps long sentences intelligible.

voices.title: One consistent voice
voices.description: A single voice is picked per session for coherence. Choose any installed system voice, including premium natural voices on macOS.

overlay.title: Floating controls
overlay.description: A draggable on-page controller lets you toggle dubbing, switch language, adjust speed and duck the original audio without leaving the video.

languages.title: 65+ languages
languages.description: Dub any subtitled video into 65+ languages — French, Spanish, Japanese, Arabic, Hindi and more. Switching languages mid-video is instant and never mixes voices.

HowItWorks.title: How it works
HowItWorks.intro: Once the extension is <install>installed</install>, everything happens on its own:

detect.title: Detects the video
detect.description: The extension finds the video player on the page — even inside shadow DOM players like Mux — and reads its English subtitle track.

translate.title: Translates ahead
translate.description: Upcoming sentences are translated ahead of playback with Chrome's local translation model, cached per language.

speak.title: Speaks over the video
speak.description: A synthesized voice speaks each sentence at the right moment while the original audio is automatically lowered.

Install.title: Install in two minutes
Install.subtitle: Pick your browser — one click to install, and updates arrive on their own.

store.title: Add it to your browser
store.description: One click from your browser's store — no developer mode, nothing to configure.

signin.title: Sign in with Google
signin.description: Open the popup and sign in — the free account unlocks dubbing. No card needed.

play.title: Play a video
play.description: Open any subtitled video and press “Start dubbing” — Voxylio speaks it in your language.

sites.question: Which sites does it work on?
sites.answer: Any site whose player exposes a subtitle track — plus the on-screen captions of YouTube, Netflix, Prime Video, Disney+ and Twitch, which Voxylio reads directly from the page. If captions are off, it can often switch them on for you. On the free plan, dubbing covers YouTube, Netflix, Prime Video, Disney+ and Twitch — the {days}-day trial and Pro unlock every other site.

cost.question: Is it really free?
cost.answer: Yes — on YouTube, Netflix, Prime Video, Disney+ and Twitch, the free plan is unlimited: translation runs on-device with Chrome's built-in API (Chrome 138+) and speech uses your system's voices. Every new account also starts with a {days}-day trial that unlocks every site. No card, no API key.

account.question: Why do I need an account?
account.answer: One Google sign-in unlocks the extension and ties your plan to it. Dubbing still runs on your device; the account stores only your email address and your plan.

pro.question: What does Pro include?
pro.answer: The big platforms stay free and unlimited with the local engine, and Pro unlocks every other site. Pro funds the features that need a server: context-aware translation (beta) — nearby sentences are sent together so pronouns, tone, names and terminology stay right — and natural neural voices in 7 languages (English, Spanish, German, French, Dutch, Italian, Japanese), each within a generous monthly allowance. When an allowance runs out, or for any other language, dubbing simply continues with the free local engine — a video is never interrupted. Summaries and cross-device sync will join Pro over time.

quota.question: What happens when a Pro allowance runs out?
quota.answer: Dubbing never stops. The moment an allowance is reached, lines continue with the free local engine, and the allowance resets with the next monthly period. No-subtitle dubbing (beta) is the one exception: it has no local fallback, so when its minutes run out it pauses until the next period.

glossary.question: Can I control how specific terms are translated?
glossary.answer: Yes — open the glossary in the extension's settings hub. “term = translation” forces your wording everywhere, and a term alone is never translated (names, brands, technical words). It applies to every engine, Pro included.

voice.question: Can I improve the voice quality?
voice.answer: Yes — install higher-quality system voices. On macOS: System Settings → Accessibility → Spoken Content → download a premium voice for your language, then pick it in the popup.

privacy.question: What about privacy?
privacy.answer: Subtitles are translated locally whenever Chrome's on-device model is available. Only when it isn't, sentences are sent to an online translation fallback. Nothing else ever leaves your browser.

youtube.question: How is this different from YouTube auto-dubbing?
youtube.answer: YouTube's dubbing only exists on YouTube. Voxylio brings the same experience — full-sentence translation, one voice, ducked original audio — to any site with subtitles.

cancel.question: How do I cancel or manage my subscription?
cancel.answer: From your account page, in two clicks, anytime. Pro stays active until the end of the period you paid for, then the plan simply returns to free — your settings and history stay.

offline.question: Does it work offline?
offline.answer: Yes for the local engine: once Chrome has downloaded the translation model for your pair, dubbing works without a connection, with your system voices. The online fallback and Pro features need one.

trial.question: How does the {days}-day trial work?
trial.answer: Every new account starts with {days} full days where every site is unlocked — no card, nothing charged automatically. When it ends, you simply keep the free plan on the big platforms; Pro brings back every site whenever you want.

Privacy.title: Privacy Policy
Privacy.intro: Voxylio is designed to work on your device. This page describes exactly what the extension does with data — and what it never does.
Privacy.p1: Voxylio reads the subtitles of the video you are watching — the player's track or the captions shown on screen — to translate them and speak them aloud. Your settings (languages, voices, speed, volume, glossary) live in your browser's extension storage, synced by Chrome on your own profile; your dubbing history and statistics stay in that local storage too, and are never transmitted. If you create an account, Voxylio additionally stores your email address and your plan — nothing more.
Privacy.p2: Translation runs on your device with Chrome's built-in translation API whenever it is available. In that mode, no text ever leaves your computer. Speech is generated by your system's voices, also locally.
Privacy.p3: When Chrome's local translator is unavailable, Voxylio can send individual subtitle sentences to an online translation service to keep the dubbing going. These are sentences from the video's public subtitles — never your personal data, browsing history or account information. You can disable this entirely with "Strict local mode" in the popup; Voxylio will then wait for the local translator instead of going online. Pro features, if you enable them, send those same subtitle sentences to the Voxylio API, which has them translated or voiced by an AI provider — same rule: only the video's subtitle text, never your personal data or browsing history.
Privacy.p4: No analytics, no tracking, no ads, no fingerprinting. Your account holds only your email address and your plan — Voxylio sells or shares no personal data, and keeps no record of what you watch on its servers: the dubbing history in the hub lives on your device only. The broad site permission is used solely to find the video player and its subtitles on the page you visit; it is never used to read anything else.
Privacy.p5: The "Reset" button in the popup restores default settings and deletes everything the extension has stored. Removing the extension removes all of its data.
Privacy.contact: Questions? Open an issue on GitHub or reach out to the author.

Terms.title: Terms of Service
Terms.intro: These terms govern your use of Voxylio — the browser extension, the website and the Voxylio account. By using Voxylio, you agree to them.
Terms.s1: Voxylio dubs subtitled videos in real time, in your browser. Free features run on your device; Pro features are provided from our servers within monthly allowances.
Terms.s2: Dubbing requires a free account (Google sign-in). You are responsible for the activity under your account, and you can unlink the extension or delete the account at any time from the account page.
Terms.s3: Local features are free and unlimited. The product evolves over time, but what runs on your device is not metered and requires no payment method.
Terms.s4: Pro is billed monthly or yearly by our payment partner Polar, acting as merchant of record. You can cancel anytime: Pro stays active until the end of the paid period, then the plan returns to free. Monthly allowances renew each period; unused volume does not carry over.
Terms.s5: Allowances are sized for personal, human viewing. Automating requests, scraping, reselling access or sharing an account beyond normal personal use may lead to suspension, after notice where possible.
Terms.s6: Voxylio reads subtitles inside your own browser, on sites you choose to visit. You remain responsible for complying with those sites' own terms. Voxylio is not affiliated with YouTube, Netflix or any platform it works on.
Terms.s7: Voxylio is provided “as is”, without warranty. Player changes, browser updates or provider outages can degrade features. To the extent permitted by law, our liability is limited to the amounts you paid in the last 12 months.
Terms.s8: We may update these terms; significant changes are announced on this page with a new date above. Continuing to use Voxylio after a change means you accept it.
Terms.contact: Questions? Open an issue on GitHub or contact the author.
